description:
About the role:

Curri is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team behind some of Curri's most critical backend services: the systems that detect anomalies, raise exceptions before they become customer problems, and help Curri build and grow its driver supply. Today these services have no dedicated manager, and the team needs formal structure, sharper focus, and stronger reliability habits. In this role, you will grow a team that starts at three engineers, raise the bar on reliability through ownership and observability, and turn business needs into well-designed services that customers like Walmart and Home Depot depend on.

What you will do:

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of engineers through regular 1:1s, direct feedback, performance reviews, and career growth, then hire and onboard new engineers as the team grows.

  • Lead the team in building and maintaining reliable, scalable backend services for anomaly detection, exception generation, and driver supply.

  • Own monitoring, alerting, and observability for the team's services using Datadog, and use that data to prioritize and drive reliability work.

  • Run delivery end to end by planning, scoping, and prioritizing work with Product and Operations partners, then making sure it ships.

  • Lead incident response and on-call for the team, including blameless postmortems and follow-through on every action item.

  • Act as the team's technical counterpart by weighing in on architecture, reviewing designs, and keeping technical debt under control, while defining clear service boundaries and ownership with other teams.

What you need to have:

  • 8+ years of experience, including at least 5 years as a software engineer and at least 3 years managing engineers, with a track record of coaching people and building healthy teams.

  • Strong technical depth in our stack: TypeScript, Node.js, and Go in a service-oriented, distributed architecture. You should be a credible partner on design and architecture decisions for backend systems at scale.

  • Comfort getting into the weeds, spending at least 30% of your time hands-on with coding, code review, and design review alongside your team.

  • Deep familiarity with observability across metrics, logs, tracing, and alerting (Datadog a plus), plus experience owning monitoring and incident response for production services.

  • An ownership mindset focused on outcomes rather than process. That means turning a vague business problem into a concrete plan, communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, staying calm during incidents, and using AI-assisted development tools yourself while pushing the team to use them too.

Bonus points for:

  • Having built an engineering team from scratch.

  • Experience running reliability or SRE work for production systems.

  • Experience with logistics, delivery, or marketplace systems.

What is in it for you?

  • Ownership of the team behind some of Curri's most critical services, with a clear path to growing it soon after you join.

  • The chance to shape a team early, as a real technical partner to your engineers rather than someone who only runs process.

  • Work that directly affects how customers like Walmart and Home Depot get their deliveries.

  • Competitive salary, equity compensation, and comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401K).

  • Remote-friendly, with the option to work from our Ventura, CA headquarters.

  • A high-growth, mission-driven environment where your work has direct and measurable impact.

Who are we?

We are Curri, and our mission is to build the network and software that move the world’s goods with speed, intelligence, and trust. Curri provides on-demand, last-mile logistics for construction and adjacent industries with our nationwide fleet of cars, trucks, and flatbeds.
Founded in 2018 and part of the YC S19 Batch, we’re solving the massive inefficiencies that exist in the construction industry. Our headquarters are in Ventura, CA. Learn more at curri.com.

Curri is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
